in_sanskrit.name: Anupam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Near, Close to
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Anupam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Anupam means ‘near’, ‘close to’, or ‘next to’. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘anu’ meaning ‘near’ and ‘pam’ meaning ‘all’. Anupam is a name that signifies being in close proximity to the divine or to the source of all creation.
